# Database

Supabase Postgres. All tables have RLS enabled. The service role bypasses RLS; adapters and server-only code use `supabaseAdmin` (service role). The browser client uses the anon key and is constrained by RLS policies.

There are **35 migration files** in `supabase/migrations/`.

**Authoritative schema source:** `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts` — regenerated by Lovable on every schema change. If this file and a migration file disagree, trust `types.ts`.

---

## Tables

### `public.sites`

Recreational water access points. 784 rows as of June 2026 (531 MD, 246 VA, 13 DC — 7 DC sites added 2026-06-24 including District Wharf Boathouse, Anacostia Community Boathouse, Washington Canoe Club, Ballpark Boathouse, Diamond Teague Park, Kingman & Heritage Islands, Buzzard Point Park).

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` PK | `gen_random_uuid()` |
| `name` | `text NOT NULL` | |
| `slug` | `text UNIQUE NOT NULL` | URL-safe identifier |
| `site_type` | `text NOT NULL` | `kayak_launch`, `boat_ramp`, `beach`, `swim_area`, `fishing_access`, `marina` |
| `water_body_type` | `text NOT NULL` | `freshwater` or `tidal_brackish` |
| `lat` | `float8 NOT NULL` | |
| `lng` | `float8 NOT NULL` | |
| `address` | `text` | |
| `description` | `text` | |
| `amenities` | `text[]` | e.g. `["parking","ada_ramp","restrooms"]` |
| `parking_notes` | `text` | |
| `ada_accessible` | `boolean` DEFAULT `false` | |
| `osm_id` | `text UNIQUE` | OpenStreetMap element id, e.g. `osm:node/12345` |
| `data_source_ids` | `text[]` | Which adapter(s) cover this site |
| `is_active` | `boolean` DEFAULT `true` | Inactive sites are hidden from map |
| `status` | `text` | `null` for standard sites; `"personal"` for user-submitted spots |
| `owner_id` | `uuid` | FK → `auth.users.id`; set for personal sites only |
| `source` | `text` | `"user"` for personal sites; adapter `sourceId` for seeded sites |
| `access_type` | `text` | e.g. `public`, `fee`, `permit` |
| `county` | `text` | County name |
| `driving_directions` | `text` | Free-text directions |
| `is_tidal` | `boolean` DEFAULT `false` | `true` when `tidal_brackish` AND `lng > -77.3` |
| `min_navigable_ft` | `float8` | Minimum tidal height (MLLW) for safe navigation |
| `nearest_gauge_id` | `uuid` | FK → `river_gauges.id` — closest USGS or NOAA gauge |
| `num_ramps` | `integer` | Number of launch ramps |
| `region` | `text` | Sub-region label (e.g. "Upper Potomac") |
| `state_code` | `text` | Two-letter state (`MD`, `VA`, `DC`) |
| `tidal_gauge_station_id` | `text` | NOAA station ID for tidal sites (e.g. `8594900`) |
| `water_body` | `text` | Named water body (e.g. "Potomac River") |
| `created_at` | `timestamptz` | |
| `updated_at` | `timestamptz` | Updated by trigger on every UPDATE |

**Indexes:** `site_type`, `water_body_type`, `is_active`, `nearest_gauge_id`

**RLS policies:**
- `"Sites are publicly readable"` — SELECT for `anon` and `authenticated`
- No INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE client policies — only service role writes

### `public.gauge_readings`

One row per USGS 15-minute stage/flow reading.

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` PK | |
| `station_id` | `uuid NOT NULL` | FK → `river_gauges.id` ON DELETE CASCADE |
| `recorded_at` | `timestamptz NOT NULL` | USGS measurement time |
| `stage_ft` | `float8` | Water surface elevation above datum |
| `flow_cfs` | `float8` | Discharge in cubic feet per second |
| `trend` | `text` | `rising`, `falling`, `steady` |
| `qualifier` | `text` | USGS qualifier code (e.g. `P` = provisional) |
| `raw_json` | `jsonb` | Original USGS IV API response |
| `created_at` | `timestamptz` | |

**Unique constraint:** `(station_id, recorded_at)` — idempotent upsert from edge function

**Indexes:** `(station_id, recorded_at DESC)`

**RLS:** `"Gauge readings are publicly readable"` — SELECT for `anon` and `authenticated`

**Important:** Column names are `station_id`, `stage_ft`, `flow_cfs` — NOT `gauge_id`, `gage_height_ft`, `discharge_cfs`. Early migration files used the old names; Lovable renamed them. The generated `types.ts` is authoritative.

### `public.monitoring_stations`

One row per water quality monitoring station (EPA WQP site or CMC station). Rows are created automatically by `fetch-water-quality` and `ingest-cmc` using metadata embedded in each result row — no separate station endpoint call is needed.

> ⚠️ **Column names below are inferred from `ingest-cmc/index.ts` and `fetch-water-quality/index.ts` INSERT payloads, not from a migration file. Verify against `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts` if in doubt.**

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` PK | |
| `station_code` | `text UNIQUE NOT NULL` | WQP `MonitoringLocationIdentifier` or `CHESAPEAKEMONITORINGCOOP-CMC.<ShortCode>` for CMC |
| `station_name` | `text` | Station display name |
| `agency` | `text` | Derived from org identifier: `USGS`, `VADEQ`, `MDE`, `DOEE`, `CMC`, etc. |
| `org_identifier` | `text` | Raw WQP `OrganizationIdentifier` |
| `data_source` | `text` | Friendly display name, e.g. `"Virginia DEQ"`, `"Maryland MDE"` |
| `lat` | `float8` | |
| `lng` | `float8` | |
| `state_code` | `text` | Two-letter state code from WQP |
| `huc8` | `text` | HUC-8 watershed code from WQP |
| `location_type` | `text` | WQP location type, e.g. `"Stream"`, `"Estuary"` |
| `is_tidal` | `boolean` DEFAULT `false` | Drives Enterococci vs. E. coli threshold selection; derived from `location_type` regex |
| `is_active` | `boolean` DEFAULT `true` | |
| `characteristics` | `text[]` | Measured parameters, e.g. `["Escherichia coli", "Enterococci"]` |
| `last_sample_at` | `timestamptz` | Updated by `fetch-water-quality` and `ingest-cmc` after each run |
| `created_at` | `timestamptz` | |

**RLS:** publicly readable.

### `public.site_station_assignments`

Many-to-many join between `sites` and `monitoring_stations`. One site can be assigned to multiple stations; one station can serve multiple sites (e.g. a shared river reach). Rows are created automatically by `fetch-water-quality` and `ingest-cmc` during assignment backfill.

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` PK | |
| `site_id` | `uuid NOT NULL` | FK → `sites.id` ON DELETE CASCADE |
| `station_id` | `uuid NOT NULL` | FK → `monitoring_stations.id` ON DELETE CASCADE |
| `assignment_type` | `text` | Optional label, e.g. `"primary"`; null for auto-assigned rows |
| `distance_m` | `float8` | Straight-line distance in metres at assignment time |
| `created_at` | `timestamptz` | |

**Unique constraint:** `(site_id, station_id)`

Both `fetch-water-quality` and `ingest-cmc` query this table to fan readings out to paddle sites (max 25 km match radius), and backfill new assignment rows for stations with data but no existing assignments.

**RLS:** publicly readable.

## Key Functions

### `get_sites_with_latest_reading(user_lat float8, user_lng float8)`

Returns all active sites with their most recent bacteria reading, most recent `gauge_readings` row (stage/flow) via `nearest_gauge_id`, and equirectangular `distance_km` from the given point. Used by `/api/sites`.

```sql
-- Distance formula (no PostGIS required):
(111.045 * sqrt(
  power(s.lat - user_lat, 2) +
  power((s.lng - user_lng) * cos(radians(user_lat)), 2)
))::float8 AS distance_km
```

Granted to `anon`, `authenticated`, `service_role`.

### `get_site_readings_history(p_site_id uuid, days_back int DEFAULT 90)`

Returns all bacteria readings for a site within the past `days_back` days (default 90), ordered by `sampled_at DESC`. Used by `/api/sites/:slug/readings`.

Granted to `anon`, `authenticated`, `service_role`.

### `nearest_water_temp(p_lat float8, p_lng float8, p_max_km float8 DEFAULT 30.0)`

Returns the single nearest water temperature observation within `p_max_km` kilometres and within the last 6 hours. Uses a bounding-box prefilter on `(lat, lng)` followed by Haversine ordering. No PostGIS required.

Returns: `(temp_c, observed_at, station_name, source, distance_km)` — one row or no rows.

Applied to the live database via Lovable migration `20260903025450` (2026-09-03). `search_path = public` set by `20260903025507`.

Granted to `anon`, `authenticated`, `service_role`.

---

### `tg_set_updated_at()` (trigger function)

Fires `BEFORE UPDATE` on `sites` and `user_profiles` to set `updated_at = now()`.

### `handle_new_user()` (trigger function)

Fires `AFTER INSERT` on `auth.users`. SECURITY DEFINER. Creates a `user_profiles` row using `ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING` so replay-safe.

### `purge_old_auth_rate_limits()`

Deletes all `auth_rate_limits` rows older than 24 hours. Called opportunistically (2% probability per request) by `checkAndRecordAttempt()`. Service role only.

### `tg_readings_notify_alerts()` (trigger function)

Fires `AFTER INSERT` on `readings`. SECURITY DEFINER. Calls the `send-alerts` Supabase Edge Function via `pg_net.http_post`. Skips when the vault URL still contains the `REPLACE_ME` placeholder.

## Private Storage

Bucket `arlington-data` (non-public). The Arlington County adapter downloads `latest.csv` from this bucket. Only `service_role` can read/write it. A restrictive storage policy blocks `anon` and `authenticated` access entirely.
